verdicts.reason: Both drop the original's full-bleed pizza photo with an overlaid band. Instead they stack a full-width orange headline band above a small inset photo, which leaves large empty white areas and loses the feel of the original. The inset photo also doesn't line up with the edge-to-edge band. A keeps the band and photo group closer to vertical centre (about 97px of white above, 125px below). B pushes the group up, leaving about 160px of dead white space at the bottom, so it is more lopsided.
